sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 100 Milestone)
sec.p: This landmark 100th archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, four classic Arkansas rural comedy chronicles with Lum and Abner (Alka-Seltzer & Frigidaire), Frank Morgan's hilarious academic absent-mindedness on *The Fabulous Dr. Tweedy*, and western vocal royalty Bob Nolan & The Sons of the Pioneers (1941–1948):
